clue.text: What demolition men do in the event of a nervous collapse

definitions.meaning: demolition crews break buildings down, a phrasal verb

explanation.surface: Wreckers at work at the very moment someone suffers a mental collapse.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb phrase means to demolish; the noun is a psychological collapse.

clue.text: Story-tellers do so to establish an association

definitions.meaning: narrators recount or tell a story
to connect one thing with another

explanation.surface: Narrators doing their job forge a connection between things.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to narrate a tale and to link two things in the mind.

clue.text: Shrewd Unionist leader in state assembly

indicators.note: an assembly puts parts together in a new arrangement, so the letters are rearranged
the leader of a word is its opening letter, here taken from Unionist

explanation.surface: A canny Unionist politician sits in a state legislature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' looks like a parliament, but it signals rearranging U (the first letter of 'Unionist') with STATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone sharp and quick to see an advantage: synonyms.

clue.text: Clear windscreen and see half the street

parts.note: demi- is a prefix meaning half

explanation.surface: A driver wipes the fogged windscreen to see a stretch of the road.
explanation.definitionFit: To remove condensation from glass so the driver can see through it.

clue.text: Sanction given to militaristic bombast

parts.note: war stands for anything militaristic
a rant is loud, overblown speech

explanation.surface: Official approval is handed to a warmonger's blustering rhetoric.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal authorisation or permit: a synonym of sanction as a noun.

clue.text: Prepared to go to accountant quietly, money in hand

parts.note: ready means prepared
CA is a chartered accountant
sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone set to visit the accountant discreetly, carrying cash.
explanation.definitionFit: Cash available immediately, banknotes held rather than owed.

clue.text: Shocking they may be, but they certainly get things done

definitions.meaning: electrified cables give a shock if touched
energetic, lively people who make things happen

explanation.surface: Some people are outrageous yet undeniably productive.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally electrified cables; figuratively vigorous, dynamic people.

clue.text: O fate, turn out to be auspicious!

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are put out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: An invocation begging fate to turn out favourably.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn out' reads as a phrasal verb, but 'turn' is fodder and 'out' is the anagram signal on O, FATE and TURN.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucky and favourable, promising good things: synonyms.

clue.text: Fine wool is more in fashion

indicators.note: to fashion something is to shape it anew, so these letters are re-formed

explanation.surface: A remark that fine wool is more popular now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in fashion' reads as trendy, but 'in' is fodder and 'fashion' is a verb meaning reshape MORE + IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Merino is a breed of sheep prized for its very soft, fine fleece.

clue.text: They have had long experience of antique clocks

definitions.meaning: veterans who have been around a long time
old timepieces, read literally as aged timers

explanation.surface: Veteran collectors know all about antique clocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Veterans of long standing; read literally, aged timekeeping devices.

clue.text: Pre-Christmas festival is coming

definitions.meaning: the church season of the four weeks before Christmas
an arrival, as in the ... of spring

explanation.surface: A festive season before Christmas is on its way.
explanation.definitionFit: The church season before Christmas, and a word for an arrival.

clue.text: An American politician?

parts.note: read literally as a man from the States, any American; also a senior political figure

explanation.surface: A question about a political figure from the US.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second reading: a man from the States, that is any American.
explanation.definitionFit: A respected political leader; split up, a man of the States.

clue.text: It's the done thing to take this to court

definitions.meaning: a deed, something that is done
a lawsuit is a legal ... brought in court

explanation.surface: Suing someone is the proper course of conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: A deed or act; also a lawsuit brought before a court.

clue.text: An ardent fan of Mr Macmillan's successor is happy to be in the house

definitions.text: is happy to be in the house

parts.note: Sir Alec Douglas-Home followed Harold Macmillan as British prime minister in 1963
a lover is an ardent devotee

explanation.surface: A devoted admirer of a prime minister enjoys sitting in Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: Alec Douglas-Home succeeded Harold Macmillan as UK prime minister; 'the house' looks like the House of Commons but is just a home.
explanation.definitionFit: A homebody, someone who prefers staying in to going out.

clue.text: Late news which can bring the papers to a standstill

definitions.meaning: last-minute news added to a newspaper after printing begins

definitions.text: which can bring the papers to a standstill
definitions.meaning: an order halting the printing machines

explanation.surface: Breaking news can halt the newspapers.
explanation.definitionFit: Late items inserted into a paper; literally an order to halt the printing machines.

clue.text: About time now to act on behalf of the others

definitions.text: act on behalf of the others

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the present is the time now

explanation.surface: Now is the moment to speak up for other people.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak or act as an agent or delegate for other people.

clue.text: Japanese outcast was fed up

indicators.note: up signals reading the letters backwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: ate is the past of eat, as in was fed

explanation.surface: A Japanese social pariah had had enough.
explanation.walkthrough: The Eta were the outcast class of feudal Japan; 'fed up' looks like 'sick of it', but 'up' turns ATE round.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta was the name of the hereditary outcast caste of old Japan.

clue.text: In France she is detailed to get the measure of old England

indicators.note: de-tailed means with its tail docked, so the final letter goes

parts.note: elle is French for she

explanation.surface: A French woman is assigned to assess old England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' reads as 'assigned' but splits as de-tailed: ELLE loses its last E.
explanation.definitionFit: The ell was an old English unit of length for cloth, about 45 inches.

clue.text: A part of the Bible well-known to the entomologist

parts.note: NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A Bible passage familiar to insect scientists.
explanation.definitionFit: An entomologist studies insects, and this is one of the commonest.

clue.text: Nothing at breakfast, lunch or dinner but porridge

parts.note: O is the round figure zero, nothing
each is a meal

explanation.surface: Someone eats nothing but porridge at every meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground oats, the stuff porridge is cooked from.

clue.text: Name a perfume which is in the process of being developed

definitions.text: in the process of being developed

parts.note: scent is perfume

explanation.surface: Naming a fragrance still being developed by the perfumer.
explanation.definitionFit: Just coming into being and beginning to grow: emerging.

clue.text: Fate of many

definitions.meaning: one's destiny, as in one's ... in life

explanation.surface: The destiny awaiting a great many people.
explanation.definitionFit: Destiny or portion in life; also a large quantity.

clue.text: Losing weight? Do eat in moderation

indicators.note: moderation changes the amount, here the order: these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to slimmers: eat sparingly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in moderation' reads as advice, but 'in' is fodder and 'moderation' the anagram signal over DO EAT IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Dieting means restricting food in order to shed pounds.

clue.text: No longer cheeky now that he's got a skill

parts.note: ex- means former, no longer
pert means saucy or cheeky

explanation.surface: A youngster stops being impudent once he masters something.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialist, a person with great proficiency in a field.

clue.text: Where pupils study a lot of aquatic creatures

explanation.surface: Students learn about a lot of sea creatures.
explanation.definitionFit: An educational institution; also a shoal of fish or whales.

clue.text: Regard them vulgarly pursuing an illustrious Italian family

indicators.note: pursuing means following behind, so this piece comes after the other

parts.note: the Este were a noble ruling house of Ferrara
'em is a casual, dropped-aitch form of them

explanation.surface: Admiration for a famous Italian dynasty, expressed coarsely.
explanation.walkthrough: The house of Este ruled Ferrara in the Renaissance.
explanation.definitionFit: High opinion or respect: a synonym of regard as a noun.

clue.text: One taking the plunge on Tuesday may provide amusement

parts.note: a diver plunges into water

explanation.surface: A diver plunging on a Tuesday entertains onlookers.
explanation.definitionFit: To entertain or amuse, turning attention away from cares.

clue.text: A group of actors in Indian dress take note of irony

indicators.note: in places the troupe inside the garment

parts.note: a sari is a garment worn by Indian women
a cast is the company of actors in a production
C is a musical note

explanation.surface: A theatre company in Indian costume notices irony.
explanation.definitionFit: Marked by cutting, mocking irony.

clue.text: Monster in progression

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits inside the clue's next word

explanation.surface: A monster appears in the progression of a story.
explanation.definitionFit: A female ogre, a fairy-tale monster.

clue.text: Can the first batsman use this if he lacks culinary skills?

definitions.text: use this if he lacks culinary skills?

parts.note: a tin is a can, the noun
in cricket the opener is the batsman who goes in first

explanation.surface: Could a cricket opener manage in the kitchen with no cooking talent?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' looks like a verb but is the noun for a metal food container; a poor cook relies on canned food.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen gadget for canned food, the resort of someone who cannot cook.

clue.text: Ascetic Jew found in West German city meeting Egyptian

parts.note: Essen is a city in the Ruhr, in former West Germany
E is an abbreviation for Egyptian

explanation.surface: A devout Jewish hermit turns up in a German city with an Egyptian.
explanation.definitionFit: The Essenes were an ancient Jewish sect living austere communal lives.

clue.text: Deadlock on board caused by partner past his best

parts.note: stale means no longer fresh, past one's best
a mate is a partner

explanation.surface: A chess standoff caused by a declining partner.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess, a position where the player to move has no legal move: a draw.
